headline: Sensex drops 319 points and Nifty falls below 25,150 as inflation concerns and crude prices weigh

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Rising crude oil prices revived inflation concerns among market participants.
Selling pressure in key financial stocks pushed benchmark indices lower.
Market rally snapped after earlier intraday recoveries failed to sustain.
Concerns over global inflation trends weighed on overall investor sentiment.
whatHappening: Sensex closed down 319 points while Nifty50 dropped to 25,144.
Paytm shares hit a record high after receiving RBI's in-principle approval to revive its wallet business.
Godrej Properties purchased a 31-acre land parcel in Indore for Rs 130 crore to construct a housing project.
Razorpay secured regulatory approval for its upcoming IPO.
summary: Indian stock markets snapped their winning streak on November 13 as Sensex fell 319 points and Nifty dipped below 25,150 due to inflation concerns and rising crude prices. Paytm shares touched a record high following RBI's in-principle nod for its wallet business, while Godrej Properties acquired 31 acres in Indore for Rs 130 crore. Shriram Finance and Manappuram Finance ended among the top losers of the trading session.
